claim_scope: The quantity is the exact equal-prior randomized-minimax value for the two constructed finite-batch correspondence worlds.
The greedy alternative-world search makes the reported ceiling conservative relative to a more adversarial feasible two-world witness; global search optimality is not claimed.
The quantity upper-bounds recovery of the frozen classifier's clean-reference prediction, not external target-label accuracy.
The quantity is not a bound on realized fixed-world method performance.
The declared cost budget is a conditional locality restriction, not evidence that every natural-shift correspondence obeys it.
No endpoint MMD, sliced-Wasserstein, C2ST, or other one-sample distance is substituted for joint-law total variation.
extension_source_policy: The final Play-3 source_files map must hash every direct extension source and every required imported dependency before any outcome is computed.
protocol_invariants: Calibration and witness rows are selected independently within each endpoint by deterministic content hashes.
Positive-control pairing and labels are used only to administer and validate the split before fitting; neither is exposed to alignment fitting or witness construction.
Both hidden worlds are exact bijections onto the identical reference multiset.
The alternative world's unperturbed geometry cost cannot exceed the prespecified relative budget.
The frozen readout and encoder provenance are inherited from a fully hash-verified V2 feature store.
The complete official ImageNet-Sketch archive and extracted source tree are byte-hashed before the lexicographically first 50 basenames per WNID are selected without outcomes.
The deterministic 50,000-image selected subset, class order, cardinality, and duplicate audit must validate before feature arrays are read.
The supplied archive's normalized decompressed image tree must equal the extracted image tree byte-for-byte.
The completed base campaign external-input manifest is byte-bound, and every supplied ImageNet-C store must match the exact condition-keyed manifest SHA before compute.
Natural-store extraction uses only the prespecified ImageNet-C brightness/severity-5 reference condition, whose exact manifest and external-input hashes remain sealed in the generated store.
ImageNet reference WNID/basename IDs, labels, class index, and head-fit stratification must agree exactly.
The fitted Bures matrix/offset and full reference mean/inverse-square-root geometry are content hashed in every unit.
Every scientific unit uses a fresh immutable output path; plan-only output is not scientific evidence.
scientific_question: What is the equal-prior randomized-minimax frozen-reference-prediction recovery ceiling across two constructed, cost-constrained finite-batch correspondence worlds that expose the same unpaired ImageNet and ImageNet-Sketch feature multisets?
